info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Status API provides real-time visibility into the status of active streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve status information, ensuring they are informed about the current operational state of their subscriptions. Typical consumers of this API include application developers and service administrators who require monitoring capabilities for subscription management. By leveraging this API, teams can quickly identify issues or confirm that services are functioning as expected.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of their subscriptions, providing necessary information on active, pending, or cancelled subscriptions.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to retrieve the current status of subscriptions. It should be filled out to ensure the correct processing of the status check.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on subscriptions status. It is a placeholder for a string value that may contain the status information.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.title: Subscription Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the subscription status retrieval operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the subscription.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the subscription status.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful subscription status retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier for the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema represents the audit information related to the subscription status action.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 means that the processing time was negligible.
